page.layout: One page of text, one column of short lines running down the page; a running head at the top; page number at top right; a catchword-like signature "LL 2 Item" at the foot right.

main_text.p: Prima Prouincia Germania habet ciuitates numero ii. Metropolis ciuitas Agrippina, id est Colonia.
Secunda Prouincia habet ciuitates numero viii.
main_text.l: Ciuitas Augusta Vindelicum, id est Auuerpurch.
main_text.p: Prouincia Batauiorum, id est Noricus Ripensis super Danubium; siue Noricum Mediterraneum habet ciuitates numero vi.
main_text.l: Metropolis ciuitas Iuuauo, id est Salzburg.
main_text.p: Prouincia Sequanorum habet ciuitates numero vii.
Prouincia Alpium Penninitarum habet ciuitates numero ii.
main_text.l: Metropolis ciuitas Centronium, id est Darantasia.
main_text.p: Prouincia Meninsis habet ciuitates numero x.
main_text.l: Ciuitas Carpentoratensis, quae nunc Vitasia dicitur.

page.notes: The first lines are cut off at the left edge of the scan; the reading "Veremundu" and several place names are doubtful due to faded print and a bleed-through from the reverse. Mixed italic and roman type throughout; some numerals in the text are uncertain. Lines were transcribed as list entries because they are short, separate lines.
